Description: Validate that the static elements and labels on the Cart page are displayed correctly.
Pre-conditions:
1. The browser is launched.
2. The user navigates to the application Base URL.
3. The user logs in successfully with a valid account (valid_user).
Steps:
1. Click the Cart link icon.
2. Verify the page title text.
3. Verify the column labels ("Description", "QTY").
4. Verify the presence and text of "Continue Shopping" and "Checkout" buttons.
Expected:
1. Page title is "Your Cart".
2. Labels "Description" and "QTY" are visible.
3. "Continue Shopping" and "Checkout" buttons are displayed with correct text.
4. Cart container elements exist.

Test Title: Verify Added Items are Visible in Cart
Description: Validate that items added from the inventory page appear in the cart list.
Steps:
1. Add a product (first_Order) to the cart from the inventory page.
2. Click the Cart link icon.
3. Check the list of items in the cart.
Expected: 1. The cart order list is not empty.

Test Title: Verify Order Can Be Removed Successfully From Cart
Description: Validate that clicking the remove button on a cart item decreases the total item count.
Steps:
1. Add multiple products (logic implies 3 items) to the cart.
2. Navigate to the Cart page.
3. Capture the initial count of items in the cart.
4. Click the "Remove" button on one of the items.
5. Capture the new count of items.
Expected: 1. The new item count is exactly 1 less than the initial count (e.g., reduces from 3 to 2).

Description: Validate that the "Continue Shopping" button redirects the user back to the product inventory page.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Cart page.
2. Click the "Continue Shopping" button.
Expected: 1. The Product Page logo is visible (indicating successful redirection).

Description: Validate that the "Checkout" button redirects the user to the Checkout Information page.
Steps:
1. Add a product to the cart.
2. Navigate to the Cart page.
3. Click the "Checkout" button.
Expected:
1. The Checkout page title is visible.
2. The title text is "Checkout: Your Information".

Test Title: Verify Cart Retains Items After Logout and Login
Description: Validate that the cart state persists across user sessions.
Steps:
1. Add products to the cart.
2. Verify the cart contains 3 items.
3. Open the Hamburger menu and click "Logout".
4. Log in again with the same valid credentials.
5. Navigate to the Cart page.

Test Title: Verify Navigation to Item Details from Cart
Description: Validate that clicking an item's name in the cart navigates to its specific details page.
Steps:
1. Add a product to the cart.
2. Navigate to the Cart page.
3. Click on the name of the first item in the list.
Expected:
1. The URL contains /inventory-item.html.
2. The "Back to products" button is visible.

Test Title: Verify 'Continue Shopping' Button Returns to Product Page (URL Check)
Description: Validate specific URL redirection for the "Continue Shopping" button.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Cart page.
2. Click the "Continue Shopping" button.
Expected:
1. The URL contains /inventory.html.
2. The Product Page logo is visible.

Test Title: Verify 'Checkout' Button Navigates to Checkout Information Page (URL Check)
Description: Validate specific URL redirection for the "Checkout" button.
Steps:
1. Add a product to the cart.
2. Navigate to the Cart page.
3. Click the "Checkout" button.
Expected:
1. The URL contains /checkout-step-one.html.
2. The page title is "Checkout: Your Information".
